description:
Wicked - What no one is talking about... 🏳️‍🌈: https://youtu.be/NrtBdKX5kKg
🔮 Ariana Grande says she's a real life witch: https://youtu.be/sy91jSzRBZI

This is a deep dive into a movie that we haven't done in a hot minute. We've previously already shown you how queer Wicked actually is, with cast members like Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo even admitting to it, and we'll go a little bit deeper into that in this episode, BUT the occult connections (think Aleister Crowley, Helena Blavatsky, the Fox sisters) to Wicked for Good is insanely deep. Unfortunately, this is a movie series that LOTS of children watch, including Christians. So, let's expose this darkness with the light of Christ, again.
